rationale: The original short thesis relied on price remaining pinned below the 5m 9-EMA ($89.50) and session VWAP ($89.68), but the last two 1-minute candles have pushed through the 9-EMA on expanding volume and are now testing VWAP at $89.67 (ask $89.79). Fighting an extreme broad-market tailwind (SPY +4.85%, VIXY -14.14%) while intraday momentum turns upward and daily loss budget is constrained warrants closing early rather than waiting for full invalidation at $90.30.
